description: Test suite for matrix reaction helper functions, verifying reaction content building, reaction summarization, event ID selection, and annotation extraction.

methods.name: buildMatrixReactionContent
methods.description: Constructs reaction content object with relation details.

methods.name: buildMatrixReactionRelationsPath
methods.description: Generates URL path for reaction relation based on room and message ID.

methods.name: extractMatrixReactionAnnotation
methods.description: Extracts reaction annotation details from relation object, ignoring non-annotation types.

methods.name: selectOwnMatrixReactionEventIds
methods.description: Filters event IDs for reactions that match the current user's sender and reaction key.

methods.name: summarizeMatrixReactionEvents
methods.description: Aggregates reactions by emoji and unique sender count.
